announcements.text: Bell Textron Inc., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $114,692,840 fixed-price-incentive, firm-fixed-price, and cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00001) to a previously awarded contract (N0001926C0140). This modification exercises an option for the H-1 structural and power improvements for Next-Gen Effects Phase III effort to procure 15 A-kits, four mission kits, nine aircraft installations, long-lead and time-critical components, associated materials and labor, and spares in support of electrical power upgrades and structural improvements to the Marine Corps AH-1Z and UH-1Y helicopters. Work will be performed in Fort Worth, Texas (38.1%); Amarillo, Texas (28.7%); Tempe, Arizona (6.3%); Grand Rapids, Michigan (4.5%); Stilwell, Oklahoma (2.6%); Anaheim, California (2.2%); Phoenix, Arizona (1.5%); Lebanon, New Hampshire (1.5%); Crestview, Florida (1.4%); Chicago, Illinois (1.1%); various locations within the continental U.S. (11%); and various locations outside the continental U.S. (1.1%), and is expected to be completed in June 2028. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $114,692,840 will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Detyens Shipyards Inc.,* North Charleston, South Carolina, is awarded a $20,454,460 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220527C0012) for the 152-calendar day shipyard availability for the Regular Overhaul and Drydocking of Military Sealift Command’s fleet replenishment oiler USNS Leroy Grumman (T-AO 195). This contract includes a base work package and four unexercised options for additional work and time, which, if exercised, would increase the cumulative value of this contract to $23,210,140.
